code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==1]

    (r0,c0),(r1,c1)=pts[-2],pts[-1]

    r,c=r1+dr,c1+dc

        r+=dr; c+=dc
    return g
